A couple quick items for our side so we can process without delay:

Hi all — thanks for the PO, Olivia. I can confirm Redwood can accept billing to a third‑party payor (CloudScale Payments, Inc.) provided we have:

Required from CloudScale AP (to process PO and remit):
- Signed PO that references the renewal/deal (we have PO-78921)
- Remit legal name and EIN (you provided EIN 12-3456789 — good)
- Billing contact email for AP (please confirm ap@cloudscale.com)
- W-9 or equivalent (we’ve attached our W-9 for your records)

Accounting note (recommended flow):
- We will issue a debit memo that references the original renewal invoice + the PO number. Debit memo preserves the original invoice footprint and makes reconciliation easier for both parties.
- Debit memo will show prorated charges for the added seats from the requested start date.
- We can put Net 30 on the generated debit memo; please confirm AP accepts Net 30 on this PO.

Next steps (to keep timelines tight):
1) Olivia: confirm AP email and that PO-78921 is final and signed by authorized signatory.
2) CloudScale AP: confirm Net 30 acceptance.
3) Vivek/Ben: confirm the activation date for the 10 seats (we need this for prorate calc).
4) Once confirmed I’ll generate the debit memo/invoice and send to ap@cloudscale.com and upload to the HubSpot deal.

Attached: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (pdf)

--
Marissa Cole
